description: This Java class 'ContactManager' manages contact synchronization operations with Android's contacts provider, including creating, updating, deleting contacts, managing groups, and handling sync states.

classes.name: ContactManager
classes.description: A class providing static methods for managing contact synchronization, including creating, updating, deleting contacts, managing groups, and handling sync states.

classes.name: ContactQuery
classes.description: Constants defining projection columns for querying contact basic info.

classes.name: DataQuery
classes.description: Constants defining projection columns for querying contact data rows.

classes.name: ProfileQuery
classes.description: Constants defining projection columns for querying profile data rows.

classes.name: UserIdQuery
classes.description: Constants defining projection columns for querying raw contact IDs by server contact ID.

classes.name: DirtyQuery
classes.description: Constants defining projection columns for querying contacts marked as dirty or deleted for sync.

classes.name: EditorQuery
classes.description: Constants defining projection columns for editing contact data.

methods.name: ensureSampleGroupExists
methods.description: Ensures a sample group exists in contacts; creates it if not, and returns its ID.

methods.name: updateContacts
methods.description: Syncs a list of raw contacts with the local contacts database, updating or adding as needed.

methods.name: getDirtyContacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts marked as dirty or deleted that need to be synced.

methods.name: updateStatusMessages
methods.description: Updates status messages for a list of contacts.

methods.name: clearSyncFlags
methods.description: Clears sync-related flags and deletes contacts marked for deletion after sync.

methods.name: addContact
methods.description: Adds a new contact to the contacts provider.

methods.name: updateContact
methods.description: Updates an existing contact's data in the contacts provider.

methods.name: setAccountContactsVisibility
methods.description: Sets visibility of contacts for a specific account.

methods.name: getRawContact
methods.description: Retrieves a RawContact object with data from the contacts database.

methods.name: updateContactStatus
methods.description: Updates the status message for a contact.

methods.name: clearDirtyFlag
methods.description: Clears the dirty flag for a contact after successful sync.

methods.name: deleteContact
methods.description: Deletes a contact from the contacts provider.

methods.name: lookupRawContact
methods.description: Finds the raw contact ID for a given server contact ID.

methods.name: lookupProfile
methods.description: Finds the profile data row ID for a given server contact ID.
